Quick answer

  • Formester for the cheapest mobile-responsive web option with offline + payments.
  • Jotform Mobile Forms for the most polished native iOS / Android app.
  • forms.app for a hybrid of web + mobile with strong AI generation.
  • Typeform if perceived UX on mobile matters more than feature depth.
  • Tally if you want unlimited free mobile forms.
  • Zonka Feedback for native kiosk / tablet CX surveys.

Side-by-side comparison of native iOS / Android apps and mobile-responsive web builders. Tested for one-handed tap targets, offline data capture, and how the form looks on a 360px screen.

The best mobile form builders in 2026 split into two camps: web-based mobile-responsive builders that work in any phone browser (Formester, Tally, Typeform, Fillout), and native iOS / Android apps that install on the device (Jotform Mobile Forms, forms.app, Zonka Feedback). Native apps win for offline-first field work; web builders win for cost-efficiency and broader browser reach.

1Editor's pick

Formester: Best mobile-responsive web builder with offline + payments

Best for: SMBs that need forms on mobile without paying per-device or per-user for a native app.

How it handles the use case

Mobile-responsive web, forms render correctly on phones from iPhone SE to iPad Pro. Offline support via browser cache + auto-sync (offline forms feature).

Key features

  • Mobile-responsive web (no app install)
  • Offline via browser cache + auto-sync
  • Six embed modes including fullscreen
  • Touch-optimized tap targets + signature pad
  • Native Stripe + PayPal at the jobsite

Pricing

  • Free Plan: Yes (100 responses/month, unlimited forms)
  • Starting Price: $13/month Personal ($12/month annual)
  • Most Popular Plan: $49/month Business ($45/month annual)
  • Enterprise Plan: Custom pricing
  • Free Trial: No (free plan available instead)
  • Response Limits: 100 (free) / 5,000 (Personal) / 15,000 (Business)
  • Storage: 100MB free / 1GB Personal / 50GB Business
  • Team Collaboration: Business plan and above
ProsCheapest in the mobile-form category. AI + offline + payments in one. No per-device fees.
ConsNot a native app, relies on browser. Less efficient than native for very heavy daily field use.
Try Formester free →
2

Jotform Mobile Forms: Best native iOS / Android app

Best for: Teams that want the most polished native mobile experience for field staff.

How it handles the use case

Native iOS + Android apps with full offline mode. Kiosk mode auto-resets between submissions. Push notifications on submission.

Key features

  • Native iOS + Android with offline
  • Kiosk mode (auto-reset)
  • 10,000+ templates
  • HIPAA-eligible on Gold ($99/mo)

Pricing

  • Free Plan: Yes (100 submissions/month)
  • Starting Price: $34/month Bronze
  • Most Popular Plan: $39/month Silver
  • Enterprise Plan: Custom pricing
  • Free Trial: No (free plan available instead)
  • Submission Limits: 100 (free) / 1,000 (Bronze) / 2,500 (Silver) / 10,000 (Gold)
  • Native Apps: iOS + Android
  • HIPAA: Gold tier and above
ProsMost mature native mobile UX. Big template library. HIPAA available.
ConsMobile app is a layer on top of regular Jotform, pricing climbs with Jotform tiers.

forms.app: Best hybrid AI-first mobile experience

Best for: Teams that want AI-generated forms + mobile-first design without sacrificing either.

How it handles the use case

Native iOS + Android apps + mobile-responsive web. Best-in-category AI form generator (per their own claim). Themes optimized for mobile.

Key features

  • Native iOS + Android + responsive web
  • Strong AI form generator
  • Mobile-optimized themes
  • Modern UI

Pricing

  • Free Plan: Yes (100 responses/month, 1 form)
  • Starting Price: $19/month Basic (annual) / $29 monthly
  • Most Popular Plan: $29/month Pro (annual) / $39 monthly
  • Enterprise Plan: $59/month Premium (annual) / $79 monthly
  • Free Trial: No (free plan available instead)
  • AI Generation: Native AI form builder
  • Native Apps: iOS + Android
ProsStrong AI form builder. Modern mobile UI.
ConsNo offline mode (online-only). Smaller integration ecosystem.

Typeform: Best perceived mobile UX for surveys

Best for: B2C marketing surveys and quizzes where the one-question-per-screen format shines on phones.

How it handles the use case

Mobile-responsive web (no native app). One-question-per-screen format is naturally phone-friendly. Strong video / image rendering.

Key features

  • One-question-per-screen format
  • Strong video + image rendering
  • Native HubSpot, Mailchimp, Salesforce, Slack
  • Visual logic flowchart editor

Pricing

  • Free Plan: Yes (10 responses/month, 1 form)
  • Starting Price: $29/month Basic ($28/month annual)
  • Most Popular Plan: $79/month Plus ($56/month annual)
  • Enterprise Plan: Custom pricing (Growth Flow tier and above)
  • Free Trial: No (free plan available instead)
  • Response Limits: 10 (free) / 100 (Basic) / 1,000 (Plus) / 10,000 (Business)
  • Pricing Save: 30% off with annual billing
ProsHighest perceived UX on mobile for conversational format.
ConsExpensive. Free tier barely usable. Wrong for long daily internal forms.

Tally: Most generous free mobile builder

Best for: Founders, indie hackers, small teams with unlimited mobile form volume needs.

How it handles the use case

Mobile-responsive web (no native app). Clean modern design that renders well on phones. Slash-command editor.

Key features

  • Unlimited responses + forms on free
  • Notion-style editor
  • Modern UI
  • Payments + logic + integrations on free

Pricing

  • Free Plan: Yes (unlimited responses + unlimited forms)
  • Starting Price: $24/month Pro
  • Most Popular Plan: $24/month Pro
  • Enterprise Plan: $74/month Business
  • Free Trial: No (free plan covers most use cases)
  • Responses: Unlimited on every tier
  • Forms: Unlimited on every tier
  • Branding Removal: Pro tier
ProsMost generous free plan in the category. Genuinely usable on phones.
ConsNo native mobile app. No offline. 'Made with Tally' footer on free plan.

Best for: Forms that read like a document on mobile, long-form intake, applications, loan / mortgage flows.

How it handles the use case

Key features

  • Strong AI builder

  • Most Popular Plan: $49/month Pro ($588/year)
  • Enterprise Plan: $99/month Business ($1,188/year)

  • Submissions: 1,200/year (Essentials) / 12,000/year (Pro) / 120,000/year (Business)
  • Users: 1 (Essentials) / 3 (Pro) / 5 (Business, +$9/user up to 25)
ProsBest layout flexibility on mobile.
ConsNo free plan. No offline. No native app.

  • Enterprise Plan: $75/month Business
  • Free Trial: No (free plan covers basics)
  • Response Limits: 1,000 (free) / 5,000 (Starter) / 25,000 (Pro) / 100,000 (Business)
  • Per-Seat Charges: None, invite your whole company
ProsGenerous free tier (1,000 responses). Strong data-layer integration.
ConsNo offline mode. No native app.

Google Forms: When you need free mobile forms with zero learning curve

Best for: Internal use cases, team polls, RSVPs, classroom surveys, viewed on phones.

How it handles the use case

Mobile-responsive web. Also viewable in the Google Workspace app. Limited offline (browser cache).

Key features

  • Free for all Google accounts
  • Native Google Sheets sync
  • Gemini AI in Google Workspace
  • Unlimited forms + submissions

Pricing

  • Free Plan: Yes (unlimited forms, no payments)
  • Starting Price: Free
  • Most Popular Plan: Free (Google Workspace from $6/user/month)
  • Enterprise Plan: Custom (Google Workspace Enterprise)
  • Free Trial: Not applicable
  • Form Limit: Unlimited
  • Native Payments: Not supported
  • Conditional Logic: Limited on free; full with Workspace
ProsFree, ubiquitous, zero learning curve.
ConsGeneric look on mobile. No payments. No conditional logic on free tier.
10

Microsoft Forms: When you're already on Microsoft 365

Best for: Internal M365 users, quick polls, internal intake, classroom forms on iPad.

How it handles the use case

Mobile-responsive web. Forms work in the Microsoft 365 mobile apps. Browser-cache only offline.

Key features

  • Included with M365 Business Standard+
  • Copilot AI form generation
  • Native Excel + Power Automate
  • M365 Education-friendly

Pricing

  • Free Plan: Included with Microsoft 365 subscription
  • Starting Price: $6/user/month (M365 Business Basic)
  • Most Popular Plan: $12.50/user/month (M365 Business Standard)
  • Enterprise Plan: $23/user/month (M365 E3) or $38/user/month (M365 E5)
  • Free Trial: Yes (30 days on M365 Business plans)
  • Standalone Pricing: Not available as standalone product
  • AI Generation: Copilot in Forms Pro
  • Native Payments: Not supported
ProsFree if you're already on M365. Strong Excel + Teams integration.
ConsNot built for customer-facing mobile forms. No real offline.

Frequently asked questions

Common questions about mobile form builders, native vs web, offline, and pricing.

What is a mobile form builder?
A mobile form builder creates forms designed to work well on phones and tablets. Some are native mobile apps (Jotform Mobile, Zonka Feedback); others are mobile-responsive web builders (Formester, Tally, Typeform).
Native app or mobile-responsive web, which is better?
For daily field use, native apps are smoother (offline, push, tap targets). For one-off submissions, mobile-responsive web is cheaper and reaches more people without an install.
Do mobile form builders work offline?
Native apps (Jotform Mobile, Zonka Feedback) handle offline natively. Among web-based, Formester is the standout, forms cache in the browser and submissions sync on reconnect.
Which mobile form builder is cheapest?
Tally has the most generous free plan (unlimited). Formester is cheapest paid at $11/mo. Jotform Mobile starts at $34/mo for paid.
Are mobile forms secure?
Yes if you choose HTTPS-only, GDPR / CCPA compliant, AES-256 at rest. Formester is GDPR / UK GDPR / CCPA; Jotform offers HIPAA on Gold+.
Can mobile forms accept payments?
Yes. Formester, Jotform Mobile, forms.app, Typeform, Tally, Paperform, Fillout, and Zoho support mobile payments via Stripe / PayPal / Square.
Photo upload and signature?
Yes for all 10 tools. Photos compress on-device and upload with the form. Signatures use the device touch screen.
Mobile form builder for kiosks?
Formester (full-screen embed), Jotform Mobile (built-in kiosk mode), Zonka Feedback (purpose-built kiosks) handle this well.
Best for AI?
forms.app leads with AI-first positioning. Formester, Jotform, and Typeform all have AI form generators with comparable output.
Embed in mobile app or PWA?
Yes. Most tools provide iframe + JavaScript embed that works inside a WebView. Formester's six embed modes give the most flexibility.
